title: fuzzyclust: fuzzy clustering and data analysis toolbox for Python
description:
fuzzyclust is a scikit-learn compatible Python toolbox for fuzzy clustering and the data-analysis methods built on it. It succeeds the Fuzzy Clustering and Data Analysis Toolbox for MATLAB (Balaskó, Abonyi, Feil, 2005) and contains fuzzy c-means, Gustafson–Kessel and Gath–Geva clustering, cluster validity indices, fuzzy Sammon mapping, possibilistic, noise, kernel and shape-prototype variants, graph-based clustering, Takagi–Sugeno model identification, time-series segmentation, and methods for relational, incomplete, very large and image data, partial supervision, co-clustering, collaborative clustering and ensembles.

The archive contains the source code, the tests, the 61 gallery examples, the Sphinx documentation and the LaTeX source of the companion book Fuzzy Clustering and Data Analysis in Python: The fuzzyclust toolbox.
